subtests.name: 01_doctor_healthy
subtests.description: Doctor reports healthy environment, required git tool, reachable loopback AO, and catalog verified

subtests.name: 02_attach_initial_create
subtests.description: Attach binds to session and creates RunManifest atomically with FREE lease state

subtests.name: 03_attach_idempotent_second_call
subtests.description: Attach returns idempotent success when called second time with identical manifest and bindings

subtests.name: 04_status_valid_manifest
subtests.description: Status reports live re-inspected lease and valid manifest metadata without modifying state

subtests.name: 05_run_unsupported
subtests.description: Coworkers run exits 1 with unsupported command error

subtests.name: 06_doctor_without_spec
subtests.description: Doctor requires --spec flag; missing flag exits 2

subtests.name: 07_doctor_with_manifest_flag
subtests.description: Doctor rejects --manifest flag; exits 2

subtests.name: 08_attach_missing_args
subtests.description: Attach requires --session, --workspace, and --manifest; missing arguments exit 2

subtests.name: 09_status_missing_file
subtests.description: Status with nonexistent manifest file exits 2

subtests.name: 10_doctor_invalid_spec_unknown_fields
subtests.description: Doctor fail-closed on RunSpec with unknown fields; exits 2

subtests.name: 11_attach_invalid_binding_branch_mismatch
subtests.description: Attach fails when worktree branch does not match session branch; exits 2

subtests.name: 12_attach_invalid_lease_locked
subtests.description: Attach fails when run lease is held by another owner (LOCKED); exits 2

subtests.name: 13_doctor_gateway_auth_error_401
subtests.description: Doctor fails on gateway 401 Unauthorized with CLIPROXY_KEY; exits 2

subtests.name: 14_doctor_closed_ao_port
subtests.description: Doctor fails on unreachable loopback AO daemon; exits 3

subtests.name: 15_doctor_model_missing_from_catalog
subtests.description: Doctor fails when required profile model is absent from gateway /v1/models catalog; exits 2

subtests.name: 16_attach_conversation_missing_effort
subtests.description: Attach fails when conversation is missing reasoning_effort; exits 2

subtests.name: 17_attach_profile_effort_mismatch
subtests.description: Attach fails when session reasoning_effort does not match RunSpec profile; exits 2

subtests.name: 18_status_gateway_override_mismatch
subtests.description: Status fails when explicit gateway URL conflicts with manifest gateway URL; exits 2

subtests.name: 19_status_trailing_json_manifest
subtests.description: Status fails-closed on corrupt manifest with trailing non-whitespace characters; exits 2

subtests.name: 20_doctor_candidate_deduplication
subtests.description: Doctor successfully deduplicates multiple candidate running.json pointing to same live PID and port

subtests.name: 21_doctor_candidate_invalid_exists
subtests.description: Doctor fails-closed when candidate running.json contains invalid JSON; exits 2

subtests.name: 22_doctor_two_different_daemons_fail
subtests.description: Doctor fails-closed without auto-selecting when multiple different live running.json daemons exist; exits 2

subtests.name: 23_attach_idempotent_when_same_run_lease_owned
subtests.description: Attach succeeds idempotently when lease transitions from FREE to OWNED by the same run owner

subtests.name: 24_doctor_and_attach_fail_when_product_root_has_agents_coworkers_file
subtests.description: Both doctor and attach fail-closed (2 separate subprocess invocations) when Product root has untracked file under .agents-coworkers/**; exits 2

subtests.name: 25_attach_fails_when_execution_workspace_has_unexpected_file
subtests.description: Attach fails-closed when execution workspace has unexpected untracked file under .agents-coworkers/**; exits 2
